answer: A concrete approach: lock a compute bond for six epochs and slash it the moment two answers fingerprint-match. Anomalous synchrony in submission timestamps is a hard tell. Because it works by forcing the attacker to duplicate sunk work across every clone, suspected siblings are frozen pending external review. The ledge of work and the pulse of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a quartz to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
